stem.text: Which statement describes a property of an ammonium ion?

A.text: An aqueous ammonium ion is a weak Brønsted–Lowry base.

B.text: Aqueous ammonium sulfate reacts with dilute hydrochloric acid to make ammonia gas.

C.text: An ammonium ion has a pyramidal shape with an H–N–H bond angle of 107°.

D.text: The four N–H covalent bonds in an ammonium ion are identical to each other.
